attr.title: BITFALL
attr.desc: Hidden in the Tomb of the Snake, the Ring of Greed awaits its rightful owner. Will you enter the tomb and live to tell the tale?
attr.inst: Download the game files (bitfall_linux_x86_64.zip) from https://tomeaves.itch.io/bitfall. Extract the zip and copy the BITFALL.pck file into the ports/bitfall/gamedata/ folder on your device.
